srs: The prosecution records system records CourtInteraction, Entry, ProsecutionModule, and CaseFile; each has an id attribute. Each CourtInteraction can have zero or more Entry records, and each Entry belongs to exactly one CourtInteraction. Each Entry uses exactly one ProsecutionModule, and each ProsecutionModule serves zero or more Entry records. Each ProsecutionModule manages one or more CaseFile records by composition, and each CaseFile belongs to exactly one ProsecutionModule. Each CourtInteraction can reference zero or more CaseFile records, and each CaseFile can be referenced by zero or more CourtInteraction records.
